source_local_excerpt: Filter cells according to minimum or maximum numbers of counts or expressed genes.
Only one of min_counts, min_genes, max_counts or max_genes may be specified per call.
Normalize counts per cell so every cell has the same total count after normalization.
target_sum sets the total count after normalization.
Compute the natural logarithm of one plus the input data.
Annotate highly variable genes; dispersion flavors expect logarithmized data while seurat_v3 flavors expect counts.
The flavor selects dispersion-based or count-based input semantics.
Compute principal components from the expression matrix, optionally using highly variable genes.
n_comps bounds the number of returned principal components.
Compute a neighborhood graph and store connectivities, distances and graph parameters.
n_neighbors controls neighborhood size.
Embed observations using UMAP from a computed neighborhood graph.
Cluster cells using the Leiden algorithm on a neighbor graph.
resolution controls cluster granularity.
Rank genes for characterizing groups; the function expects logarithmized data.
Cell-level tests do not model biological replicate structure; experimental differential expression should use replicate-aware pseudobulk or equivalent models.
Normalize feature expression measurements for each cell by total expression and apply a log transformation.
scale.factor sets the per-cell normalization scale.
Identify features that are outliers on a mean-variability relationship.
nfeatures controls how many variable features are returned.
Run PCA on the scaled data matrix, using variable features by default.
Construct a k-nearest-neighbor graph from a dimensional reduction.
dims selects dimensions used for graph construction.
Identify cell communities from a nearest-neighbor graph.
resolution controls community granularity.
Find markers differentially expressed between identities of cells.
Cell-level marker testing does not by itself encode biological-replicate structure.
Integrate a PCA embedding over specified covariates with Harmony and return corrected embeddings.
Harmony integrates cells across diverse experimental and biological conditions in a low-dimensional embedding.
group.by.vars names the variables whose effects are removed.
Harmony corrects an embedding and does not create a corrected count matrix.
Register count data and optional batch covariates for scVI model construction.
scVI is a probabilistic framework for normalization and analysis of single-cell gene-expression data with batch effects.
Train an scVI variational model on registered single-cell count data.
max_epochs limits model training epochs.
Return the latent representation from a trained scVI model.
Register paired RNA counts, protein counts and optional batch covariates for totalVI.
totalVI jointly models paired transcriptomic and protein measurements from single cells.
Train a totalVI model on registered paired RNA and protein measurements.
Return a joint latent representation for registered RNA and protein measurements.
The joint RNA-protein operator requires protein measurements aligned to the modeled observations.
Simulate doublets from the observed count matrix and score observed transcriptomes for doublet likelihood.
Scrublet detects doublets by comparing observed transcriptomes with simulated doublets.
expected_doublet_rate records the expected doublet fraction.
Doublet-score calibration depends on the sampled population and expected doublet rate.
Estimate the global ambient RNA contamination fraction using expression and clustering information.
SoupX estimates and removes cell-free messenger RNA contamination from droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing data.
Reliable automatic contamination estimation requires informative marker structure and clustering.
Remove estimated ambient RNA contamination from observed count data.
Annotate cells using a CellTypist classifier and return predicted labels and decision scores.
CellTypist enables automated cell-type annotation using reference-trained models.
majority_voting optionally refines predictions using over-clustering.
Predictions are constrained by the cell types represented by the selected reference model.
Annotate query cells by comparing their expression profiles with labeled reference samples.
SingleR annotates single-cell transcriptomes by comparison with reference transcriptomic datasets of pure cell types.
Annotation quality depends on compatible feature identifiers and relevant cell types in the reference.
Construct an edgeR count object from non-negative count data and sample metadata.
edgeR performs empirical analysis of digital gene-expression data using overdispersed count models.
Calculate normalization factors for library composition in an edgeR count object.
method selects the normalization-factor estimator.
Fit negative-binomial generalized linear models with quasi-likelihood dispersion estimation.
Valid inference requires a design matrix that represents the biological replicate structure and tested contrast.
Conduct a quasi-likelihood F-test for specified coefficients or contrasts.
Infer branching lineages and continuous pseudotime from reduced coordinates and cluster labels.
Slingshot provides robust lineage and pseudotime inference for single-cell transcriptomics.
start.clus constrains the starting cluster when prior knowledge is available.
Inferred lineage topology depends on the supplied reduced representation and cluster labels.
Compute first and second order moments for velocity estimation using a neighborhood graph.
scVelo generalizes RNA velocity through likelihood-based dynamical modeling.
Estimate RNA velocities from spliced and unspliced moments.
mode selects the velocity model.
Compute a velocity graph containing transition probabilities between cells.
Compute a cell-to-cell transition matrix from RNA velocity and neighborhood information.
CellRank combines cellular dynamics with transcriptomic similarity to estimate cell-state transition probabilities and fate probabilities.
Compute macrostates from a transition matrix using generalized Perron cluster analysis.
Compute absorption probabilities toward selected terminal states.
Fate probabilities depend on the transition kernel and the selected terminal-state definition.
Create a MOFA model from one or more aligned omics views.
MOFA+ provides a statistical framework for the integration of multi-modal data through latent factors.
Prepare model, data and training options before fitting MOFA.
Train a MOFA model and expose latent factors and feature weights.
Interpretation is scoped to the supplied views, feature preprocessing and sample alignment.
Infer transcription-factor target adjacencies from an expression matrix.
The SCENIC workflow reconstructs gene-regulatory networks and identifies stable cell states from single-cell RNA-sequencing data.
Prune co-expression modules with motif enrichment to derive regulons.
Motif pruning additionally requires compatible ranking databases, motif annotations and a transcription-factor list.
Calculate per-cell enrichment of regulon target genes from ranked expression.
